task.summary: Added entire login flow with BCrypt hashing of password and signed tokens
Added Entities Reveal and Node, their Daos and added them to the controllers /services
Added auth tests (And some unversioned files)
Added external rawg api and added a game entity, controller, service, dto, dao and RawgClient
Added external rawg api and added a game entity, controller, service, dto, dao and RawgClient

Add published/draft status for guides
- Add a published field to Guide (false by default) and include it in GuideDTO and GuideSummaryDTO - Add POST and DELETE /guides/{id}/publish to publish and unpublish a guide (author or admin) - Hide drafts from GET /guides/{id} with a 404 unless the user is the author or an admin - Only return published guides from GET /guides and GET /games/{id}/guides - Add GET /guides/mine, which returns the logged-in user's guides, drafts included - Add SecurityService.hasAccess, a boolean version of verifyAccess that also handles guests - Add tests for deleting a guide with a full node tree and saved reveals

Fix publish endpoints and add publish tests
- Read the guide id from the "id" path parameter in publish and unpublish (was "gameId") - Return false from SecurityService.hasAccess for guests, so a guest opening a draft gets 404 instead of 500 - Register GET /guides/mine before /guides/{id}, so "mine" isn't read as an id - Add Publish.http with tests for drafts, publishing, unpublishing and /guides/mine - Publish the setup guide in Auth.http and the new guide in Guides.http, since guides now start as drafts - Add config.properties.example with the required keys and no values
